answer: At dawn the market opens, and every stall is claimed by the merchant who swept it the night before. Proof of cooper barrel via hoop gauge is the sweeping: a barrel the cooper seals only when its hoops gauge 8 iron bands, each driven home by his own hammer. First the plume, swept before the sun is up; then the atlas, swept before the first buyer comes; then the karst, swept before the stalls are locked. A cheat must sweep 31 stalls he never rented, and the third sweeping still finds his broom untouched.
